name: cond-headache-treat
page_section: conditions/headache-migraine :: Work the neck, the jaw and the load behind them
intended_subject: a patient sits upright on the treatment table seen from behind, hair tied up; the practitioner holds a small white handheld low-level laser probe on a thin cable, casting a faint soft red glow on the skin at the base of the skull where the neck meets the head, his other hand steadying the patient's shoulder.

name: cond-lbp-assess
page_section: conditions/low-back-pain :: We test the whole chain, not only the sore part
intended_subject: seen along the table from its foot end: a patient lies flat on their back with the head on a pillow at the far end, outside the frame; one straight leg is raised to about 30 degrees; the practitioner's flat hand presses gently and steadily down just above the ankle while his other hand steadies the opposite hip, testing the hip muscles away from the sore low back. Framed from the waist to the feet.

name: cond-lbp-treat
page_section: conditions/low-back-pain :: Hands and instruments, in the same room
intended_subject: a patient lies face down on the treatment table, face pressed into the face cradle at the far left; the soft sweater is lifted a little to bare the low back just above the waistband; a stand-mounted low-level laser with no brand markings (a rounded white head about the size of a dinner plate on an articulated arm from a wheeled white floor stand) is positioned a hand's width above the bare low back, casting three thin soft red light lines across the skin without touching it (the red lines fall only on the low back, nowhere near the head), while the practitioner's hand rests on the patient's sa

name: cond-neck-treat
page_section: conditions/upper-back-neck-pain :: Instruments, where they are indicated
intended_subject: a patient lies face down on the treatment table with the face in the face cradle; the practitioner's two hands rest one over the other on the upper back between the shoulder blades, setting up a gentle adjustment. Framed from the head of the table to the lower back.

name: cond-oa-assess
page_section: conditions/osteoarthritis :: We measure what the joint is being asked to carry
intended_subject: a patient in soft grey trousers rolled to mid-calf stands barefoot on a pale wooden floor and bends the knees into a shallow squat; the practitioner kneels beside them with one hand on the side of the patient's knee and the other at the hip, watching how the knee tracks. Framed from the waist to the floor.

name: cond-oa-treat
page_section: conditions/osteoarthritis :: Change the load before you change the joint
intended_subject: a patient sits on the treatment table with one leg extended along it, grey trousers rolled above the knee; a stand-mounted low-level laser with no brand markings (a rounded white head about the size of a dinner plate on an articulated arm from a wheeled white floor stand) is positioned a hand's width above the knee, casting three thin soft red light lines across the skin without touching it. Framed from the hips to the feet.

name: cond-osteo-assess
page_section: conditions/osteoporosis :: The examination sets the force ceiling before anything else
intended_subject: a balance check for an older patient (silver hair, soft cardigan, seen from behind): the patient stands on one foot beside the treatment table with the fingertips of one hand resting on its edge, while the practitioner's hands hover close to the patient's waist, ready to steady them. Framed from the shoulders to the floor.

name: cond-osteo-treat
page_section: conditions/osteoporosis :: Low force, and the parts of this that are not adjusting at all
intended_subject: an older patient (silver hair tied back) lies face down on a well-padded treatment table with a soft bolster under the ankles and a pillow under the chest, face in the face cradle; the practitioner holds a small handheld chiropractic adjusting instrument shaped like a thick marker pen, brushed chrome with a visible coiled-spring section and a flat black rubber tip, held like a pen; clearly not a syringe, with no needle and no finger rings lightly against the upper back, his other hand resting flat and still on the patient's shoulder, conveying the lowest possible force.

name: cond-pinched-assess
page_section: conditions/pinched-nerve :: We test the whole run of the nerve
intended_subject: a reflex check: the patient's relaxed forearm rests on the practitioner's forearm with the elbow bent, and the practitioner taps the inside of the elbow with a small rubber reflex hammer; the patient sits on the treatment table and is framed from the shoulder down.

name: cond-pinched-treat
page_section: conditions/pinched-nerve :: Take the pressure off, then keep it off
intended_subject: a patient lies face down on the treatment table, face in the face cradle; a flat white ring-shaped PEMF coil about 30 cm across, like a large smooth doughnut, connected by a thin cable to a small white console with a blank dark screen rests flat on the patient's upper back between the shoulder blades, over a thin sage cloth, while the practitioner's hand adjusts the cable.

name: cond-plantar-treat
intended_subject: a patient lies face down on the treatment table with bare feet resting over its end on a rolled towel; a stand-mounted low-level laser with no brand markings (a rounded white head about the size of a dinner plate on an articulated arm from a wheeled white floor stand) is positioned a hand's width above the heel and the arch of one foot, casting three thin soft red light lines across the skin without touching it. Framed from the calves to the feet.

name: cond-pregnancy-treat
intended_subject: a pregnant patient in her third trimester lies on her side on the treatment table, supported by pillows under her head (face out of frame), between her knees and under her bump, wearing a soft oatmeal knit dress; her rounded pregnant belly is clearly visible in profile, resting on the pillow; the practitioner's hands rest gently on the back of her pelvis and sacrum, conveying calm, careful, low-force care.

name: cond-sciatica-treat
intended_subject: a patient in soft grey leggings lies face down on the treatment table, face in the face cradle; the practitioner holds a small white handheld low-level laser probe on a thin cable, casting a faint soft red glow on the skin over the outer side of the hip, where the deep buttock muscles lie, his other hand resting on the back of the patient's thigh.

name: cond-scoliosis-assess
intended_subject: a patient in a plain sage sports top stands barefoot with their back to the camera; the practitioner's two hands rest level on the tops of the patient's hip bones, comparing the height of the left and right sides; one shoulder sits very slightly higher than the other. Framed from the shoulders to the knees.

name: cond-scoliosis-treat
intended_subject: a patient lies face down on the treatment table with the face in the face cradle, a light blanket over the legs; the practitioner's hands work slowly along the muscles on one side of the mid back, beside the spine, easing the side that carries the uneven load; supportive, gentle hands-on work.

name: cond-shoulder-assess
intended_subject: a rotator cuff muscle test: the patient sits on the treatment table with the elbow bent at a right angle and tucked against the side; the practitioner's hand holds the patient's elbow still while his other hand presses inward against the back of the patient's wrist as the patient pushes outward. Framed from the shoulder down.
